sessions.focus: baseline reverification, first traceability audit, streaming pipeline + frame lifecycle fixes
deep-dive on the five previously spot-checked areas, run-versioning fault matrix, pushdown adapter audit, streaming memory smoke, full documentation set

critical_findings.title: iter_chunk_windows frame lifecycle relied on implicit GC
ATTN_IMPL=flash_attention_2 had no dependency/GPU capability check
_copy_clickhouse_legacy had no idempotency guard against duplicate rows on retry
Migration retry-after-failure could never activate (status='validating' never reset)
telemetry.py hardcoded UTC for naive iso8601 timestamps, ignoring manifest.timezone
categorical telemetry fields had no interpolation/aggregation validation

areas.evidence: Hash chain (source/model detail manifests + top-level bundle manifest, three SHA-256 layers) rejects missing/modified files and model_id/revision/source_commit mismatches; docker-compose.gpu.yml mounts bundle read-only with matching QWEN_REPO_PATH/QWEN_MODEL_PATH; Dockerfile.gpu never clones/downloads at build time; flash_attention_2 selection now gates on flash_attn import + GPU compute capability >= 8.0.
areas.remaining_work: Real bundle download and real GPU verification - not_run, no hardware this session.

areas.evidence: Had zero test coverage before this session. Found and fixed M1 (ClickHouse copy step duplicated rows on retry) and M2 (retry after failure could never activate). plan_migration() proven read-only by static source scan; legacy tables proven never DROP/TRUNCATE/written outside ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; --apply is a distinct required CLI flag; Qdrant-enabled plans block without touching the active pointer; pgvector genuinely lives in the same pg container image (no separate service).
areas.remaining_work: Live --plan/--apply against real PostgreSQL/ClickHouse - not_run (psycopg2 not installed on this host, Docker daemon not running).

areas.evidence: No defects found; only test coverage gaps closed. Parent traversal, symlink escape (skips if host lacks permission), encoded-traversal segment_id proven to be an opaque DB key only, negative/reversed time ranges, ffmpeg arg-list, atomic cache publish, HMAC constant-time compare, no token leak in signed URLs, real expiry, cross-path/cross-endpoint signature reuse rejection.
areas.remaining_work: None identified beyond live HTTP-level fuzzing (not_run, no Docker daemon).

areas.evidence: Had zero direct no-write test coverage before this session. Real before/after filesystem snapshots (size+mtime_ns+sha256) around dataset files, a fixture model bundle under a real EMBEDDING_MODE=real verify_bundle() pass, the whole fixture tree, and an intentionally-broken manifest all show zero writes. Static source scan confirms preflight.py never references app.db.postgres/app.db.clickhouse/init_schema/app.ingestion.ingest.
areas.remaining_work: scripts/preflight.py's host-level subprocess checks (docker, nvidia-smi) not exercised live - not_run, read-only by inspection of the exact commands invoked.

areas.production_call_path: load_manifest(), TelemetrySeries.from_csv()/align_timestamp() (called from both ingest and preflight)
areas.evidence: Found and fixed T1 (naive-timestamp timezone bug) and T2 (categorical interpolation/aggregation not validated). Heading fields proven never implicitly cross-mapped (no auto-mapping code exists at all); altitude/velocity semantics survive onto the parsed field; extra telemetry doesn't get dropped or conflated with canonical fields; offset sign matches the docstring for both clocks.

9 of 10 injected-failure points proven pass with real fake-adapter tests; point 10 (failure mid active-pointer transaction) is pass_by_code_inspection_not_live_run - depends on real PostgreSQL/psycopg2 rollback-on-close semantics a fake store cannot exercise.
areas.remaining_work: Point 10 requires a live PostgreSQL connection to prove for real - not_run.

areas.evidence: ClickHouse/Qdrant/pgvector all build real backend-native query/filter objects (not Python candidate lists); test_active_pushdown_never_materializes_candidate_ids exercises the real production search() call path; PATTERN_EXECUTION_IMPLEMENTED=False preserved and pattern never drives execution_mode.
areas.remaining_work: NULL semantics consistency marked pass_by_code_inspection (relies on standard SQL/backend null semantics, no live cross-backend run this session). Live equivalence/scale acceptance not_run.

areas.evidence: F1/F2 fixed in session 1. Session 2 adds real instrumented evidence: a synthetic 60s/10fps video processed 59 windows while DECODE_PREFETCH_WINDOWS=5 never exceeded 5 live window records / 20 live PIL frames at any point.
areas.remaining_work: status=pass_synthetic_smoke - not institution acceptance evidence. Known residual gap: partial-prefetch-group frame cleanup on a decode-side exception (bounded impact, not fixed this session).
